extensionName.message: HiTable: Instant Analysis of Web Page Table Data

extensionDescription.message: Analyze data instantly on web page tables, without leaving the page, without copying data, without Excel.

demoIntro.message: Try HiTable on the sample tables below. Click the extension icon to activate, then drag-select across any table to see statistics instantly.

demoTable1Desc.message: A typical numeric table with many narrow columns. Try selecting all data columns to see SUM, AVG, MIN, MAX across sectors.

demoTable2Desc.message: This table uses rowspan and colspan. HiTable flattens merged cells into a logical grid automatically for correct statistics.

demoTable3Desc.message: A parent table with quarterly totals, some cells containing monthly breakdown tables. HiTable recursively flattens nested tables into one unified grid.

demoTable4Desc.message: A detailed sales table with narrow columns. HiTable handles currency (K=thousands), percentages, and numeric abbreviations for clean statistics.

demoTable5Desc.message: This dataset contains outliers and artificially generated values. After activation, try selecting numeric columns to see anomaly detection in action.

demoTable6Desc.message: This table is built with <div> elements and CSS Grid — no <table> tags. HiTable detects it by analyzing its CSS class names and child element geometry.

demoTable7Desc.message: This table uses ARIA role="grid" for accessibility. HiTable detects it via semantic markers — no CSS class matching needed.

integrityBenfordFlag.message: First-digit distribution deviates from Benford's Law (D=$1$)

integrityLastDigitUneven.message: Last digit distribution is uneven (may be human-generated)

integrityRoundingFlag.message: $1$% of values end in 0 or 5 (unusual rounding preference)

integrityDuplicateFlag.message: Value appears $1$ times ($2$% of data) — possible copy-paste

integrityMonotonicFlag.message: Sorted values are too linear (R²=$1$%) — may be auto-filled

integrityRatioFlag.message: Column $1$ / Column $2$ ratio is nearly constant ($3$) — may be formula-generated

conditionalFormattingDesc.message: Highlight anomalies (values deviating from average by 2× std dev) in the selected range with a slow pulse.

anomalyReasonColumn.message: Within column: deviates from column avg $1$

anomalyReasonRow.message: Within row: deviates from row avg $1$

helpSubtitle.message: Instant analysis of web page table data — without leaving the page

helpUsage1.message: Click the HiTable icon in your browser toolbar to activate it on the current page.

helpUsage2.message: Drag your mouse across table cells to select a range of data.

helpUsage3.message: Statistics appear on four sides of the selection: top, right, bottom, left.

helpUsage4.message: Click an algorithm button at an outer corner to choose a statistic for that edge.

helpUsage5.message: Press Esc to clear the selection. Press Ctrl+C (⌘C on Mac) to copy the selected cells. A notification confirms the copy result and selection size.

helpUsageDoubleCopy.message: Double-press Ctrl+C quickly to copy the entire overlay (including statistics) — paste directly into Excel or Numbers.

helpUsageShift.message: Hold Shift and click the top-left cell of a table to select the entire table at once.

helpUsageNonNumeric.message: Non-numeric cells are greyed out and skipped in calculations; their original text is still copied.

helpUsageCrosshair.message: Moving the mouse within the selected area highlights a cross-hair to help you match rows and columns to their statistics.

helpTableType1.message: Standard HTML table elements — including complex ones with merged cells (rowspan/colspan).

helpTableType2.message: Nested tables inside tables — HiTable recursively flattens them into one unified grid.

helpTableType3.message: CSS Grid / Flexbox tables (div-based) — detected by CSS class patterns and geometric analysis.

helpTableType4.message: Elements with role='grid' or role='table' — detected via semantic markers.

helpAlgoBasicList.message: CNT (Count), SUM (Sum), AVG (Average), MIN (Minimum), MAX (Maximum), RNG (Range)

helpAlgoQuantileList.message: Q1 (25th percentile), Q3 (75th percentile), IQR (Interquartile Range)

helpAnomaly1.message: When you select a data range, HiTable automatically checks for anomalous values.

helpAnomaly2.message: An anomaly is a value that deviates from the mean by more than 2× standard deviation.

helpAnomaly3.message: Detection runs at three levels: across the entire selection, within each column, and within each row.

helpAnomaly4.message: Anomalous cells are highlighted with a slow pulsing animation in your chosen theme color.

helpAnomaly5.message: Hover over an anomalous cell to see why it was flagged and at which level.

helpAnomaly6.message: You can toggle this feature on/off in the configuration page.

helpIntegrity1.message: Benford's Law: Checks if the first-digit distribution follows natural patterns. Deviations may indicate fabricated data.

helpIntegrity2.message: Last Digit Analysis: Detects uneven last-digit distribution — humans tend to avoid certain digits when inventing numbers.

helpIntegrity3.message: Rounding Preference: Flags when too many values end in 0 or 5 (common in manually filled data).

helpIntegrity4.message: Duplicate Detection: Identifies values that appear unusually often — possible copy-paste.

helpIntegrity5.message: Ratio Anomaly: Detects when two columns have a near-constant ratio — may be formula-generated.

helpIntegrity6.message: Monotonic Sequence: Checks if sorted values are too linear — possible auto-fill pattern.

helpIntegrity7.message: Results appear as a warning indicator below the overlay. Hover to see details. Problematic cells are marked with colored outlines.

helpFormat1.message: Currency symbols ($, €, £, ¥, ₹, ₽, HK$, NT$) and RON, MDL, leu/lei before or after a number are recognized and removed for calculation.

helpFormat2.message: Magnitude suffixes are recognized: K (×1,000), W/万 (×10,000), M (×1,000,000), B (×1,000,000,000).

helpFormat3.message: Percentages are detected and converted: "12.5%" becomes 0.125 for calculation.

helpFormat5.message: Statistical results retain the source decimal format, currency position and magnitude suffix when consistent across a column or row. No currency conversion is performed.

helpFormat6.message: Column types (integer, decimal, currency, percentage) are shown in tooltips.

helpConfigDesc.message: Right-click the extension icon and select 'Config', or go to the extension options page. You can customize:

helpConfig1.message: Activation Mode: Manual (click to activate per tab) or Auto (activate on specific domains).

helpConfig2.message: Theme Color: Choose from 11 designed themes for the selection and overlay.

helpConfig3.message: Enabled Algorithms: Select which statistics appear in the algorithm menus.

helpConfig4.message: Default Algorithms: Set the default statistic for each edge of the overlay.

helpConfig5.message: Conditional Formatting: Toggle anomaly highlighting on/off.

helpConfig6.message: Number format: Automatic detects separators and uses the table/browser language for ambiguous values. In Config, choose decimal comma or decimal point to interpret values such as 1,234 correctly.

helpMenuDesc.message: Right-click the HiTable icon in your browser toolbar to access:

helpMenuConfig.message: Config — Open the configuration page to customize algorithms, colors, activation mode, and more.

helpMenuDemo.message: Demo — Open the demo page with sample tables to try all features.

helpMenuReport.message: Report Error — Report a bug or issue on GitHub. Please include the page URL and a description of the problem.

helpShortcutCopy.message: Copy selected cell data (double-press to copy entire overlay)

helpShortcutCorner.message: Click an outer-corner algorithm button to open its menu.

numberFormatHelp.message: Choose the source format if a value such as 1,234 is ambiguous. Spaces may separate digit groups.

helpFormatRegional.message: Romanian and Moldovan numbers: a comma separates decimals; a dot or space groups digits. Both 1.234,56 and 1 234,56 represent 1234.56.

demoTable8Desc.message: Try decimal commas, grouped digits, and RON, lei or MDL. Select each currency column separately; no currency conversion is performed.

helpSelectionMode.message: While active, HiTable takes over table selection. Click the HiTable icon in the browser toolbar again to deactivate it and restore the page’s original table actions. Display, statistics and copying use the same snapshot captured when dragging starts. Press Esc to clear the selection, then drag again to refresh the data; Esc does not deactivate HiTable.

themeAuto.message: Automatic — choose a preset for the page background

themeFixed.message: Fixed — use the selected colour on every page

themeHelp.message: Automatic uses light Neutral Graphite on white, grey and beige pages, and a dark variant on dark neutral pages. Solid swatches keep a fixed palette.

resize_nw.message: Resize selection from the top left; drag or use arrow keys

resize_ne.message: Resize selection from the top right; drag or use arrow keys

resize_sw.message: Resize selection from the bottom left; drag or use arrow keys

resize_se.message: Resize selection from the bottom right; drag or use arrow keys

copySuccessStatistics.message: Copied selection and statistics: $1$ rows × $2$ columns

nonNumericCell.message: Not included in numeric statistics. The original text is still copied.

helpResizeSelection.message: Drag a handle at a data corner to resize the selection; arrow keys also work when a handle is focused. Resizing keeps the same table snapshot. Esc during a resize restores the previous range.

helpThemeSelection.message: Choose the multicolour button for Automatic or a solid swatch for a fixed palette. Automatic follows the page background, not the browser toolbar: white, grey and beige pages use light Neutral Graphite; dark neutral pages use its dark variant. Fixed palettes (including light Graphite) and colourful palettes are never inverted. When Automatic is selected, this page previews light Neutral Graphite. The overlay follows the background of each webpage.

themeAutoPreview.message: When Automatic is selected, this page previews light Neutral Graphite. The overlay follows the background of each webpage.

demoBackgroundHelp.message: To try automatic colours, first select Automatic in Config. Switch the background colour and light/dark setting here, then drag-select table cells again to see how HiTable chooses an overlay palette for the page background. Compare its appearance on different backgrounds. Fixed themes keep the selected palette; these controls only change the demo page.
